EFFECT.EnforceSingleMaterialError: This item already has a standard Material effect. Only one is allowed when Enforce Single Material is enabled.
EFFECT.IncompleteChangesWarning: This effect has incomplete changes that will not be applied.

initial.label: Initial
initial.hint: Applied early, before item-derived data settles (e.g. carried weight, equipped status).

final.label: Final
final.hint: Applied after derived data is computed - most bonuses and penalties belong here.

post.label: Post
post.hint: Applied after Final fully settles - for stats derived from other Final-phase stats (e.g. saves, AC).

Secret.RevealAllHint: Disable all Secret effects, revealing the item's true properties
Secret.EmptyMasks: No masks defined. Add a mask to hide a field value from players.

isPlayerEditSecret.label: Player Edit Secret
isPlayerEditSecret.hint: This secret was automatically created from a player's edit on a masked field.

isSystem.label: System Effect
isSystem.hint: Whether this effect is a built-in system effect and should not be edited by users.

showIcon.label: Show Icon
showIcon.hint: Whether to show the effect's icon on the actor sheet when this effect is active.

statuses.label: Status Effects
statuses.hint: A list of status effects to apply to the actor when this effect is active.

tint.label: Tint
tint.hint: A color tint to apply to the actor's token when this effect is active.

duration.label: Duration
duration.hint: The duration of this effect in rounds. The effect will automatically expire when the duration reaches 0.

value.label: Duration Value
value.hint: The current duration of this effect in rounds.

units.label: Duration Units
units.hint: The units for the duration of this effect.

takeDamage.label: Take Damage
takeDamage.description: Fires when damage is applied to the actor HP.

dying.label: Dying
dying.description: Fires when the actor HP drops to 0 or below, but above the death threshold.

death.label: Death
death.description: Fires when the actor HP drops to the world death threshold.

revealSecret.label: Reveal Secret
revealSecret.description: Fires when a Secret AE is disabled, revealing the true value of a masked field.

sourceContainerId.label: Source Container
sourceContainerId.hint: The container this item is stowed in.

makesWeightless.label: Makes Weightless
makesWeightless.hint: Whether this containment zeroes the item's weight.

price.label: Price
price.hint: The price modifier for this material.

magicEquivalency.label: Magic Equivalency
magicEquivalency.hint: The magic equivalency of this material.

bonusHp.label: Bonus HP
bonusHp.hint: The bonus max HP provided by this material.

materialSubtype.label: Subtype
materialSubtype.hint: What type of material is this?
